answer: Echo-burst shatter: each epoch the network fires a random burst of small signed echo challenges at every identity, cipher-wrapped so responses cannot be replayed or spoofed. The response curve - timing, throughput, error shape - is compared against the identity's own historical envelope, the jade lattice it hardened through graded work. A farm bursting N fresh identities beyond plausible single-agent capacity shatters: flagged clones burn their bond. Attacker cost = running N real agents at burst capacity, because scripted echoes betray themselves in timing statistics.
